sources.title: Scene understanding using vision language models
sources.snippet: Using Large Language Models (LLMs) for scene understanding in AV can present challenges. The daily generation of terabytes of data by vehicles makes scalable image analysis difficult from a computational point of view. Small Language Models (SLMs) are more efficient but lack the domain knowledge required for effective scene analysis and need fine-tuning on domain-specific data.

sources.title: OpenSU3D: Open World 3D Scene Understanding using Foundation Models
sources.snippet: Additionally, we explore large language models for robust automatic annotation and spatial reasoning tasks. We evaluate our proposed approach on multiple scenes from ScanNet and Replica datasets demonstrating zero-shot generalization capabilities, exceeding current state-of-the-art methods in open world 3D scene understanding.

sources.title: GPT4Scene
sources.snippet: To address this, we introduce GPT4Scene, a novel visual prompting paradigm in VLM training and inference that helps build the global-local relationship, significantly improving the 3D spatial understanding of indoor scenes.

sources.title: SceneGPT: A Language Model for 3D Scene Understanding
sources.snippet: Building models that can understand and reason about 3D scenes is difficult owing to the lack of data sources for 3D supervised training and large-scale training regimes. In this work we ask - How can the knowledge in a pre-trained language model be leveraged for 3D scene understanding without any 3D pre-training.
